id.description: ID for the input/textarea field. Used to wire label, hint, message, and error/success spans.

max.description: Maximum number of characters allowed. Rendered as the field's maxlength attribute and referenced in the fallback message; USWDS JS moves it to data-maxlength and manages the live count/over-limit state at runtime.

hint.description: Hint text displayed below the label, referenced by aria-describedby.

error.description: Error message (string) or true to mark the field as invalid without a message.

success.description: Success message (string) or true to mark the field as valid without a message.

screenReaderOnlyLabel.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it screen-reader accessible.

textArea.description: Renders a textarea instead of an input.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer character-count wrapper.
